name: alerts-stream

graded_by.test: core/internal/alert/stream_test.go — GET /alerts sends the active set, then each raise and clear; a keepalive comment every heartbeat_interval; the stream ends on logout, on expiry and on a policy reload that removes broker.health; a gone supervisor's alerts clear, audited

description: The operator alert stream (session model §11; Tu, 2026-09-26): a text/event-stream behind broker.health, cookie-authenticated. On connect one alert event per alert active now, then each raise and clear, a clear naming its raise's alert_id; a reconnecting surface gets the active set again. A comment line whenever no event was sent for heartbeat_interval, so no proxy closes an idle stream. Authorization holds for the stream's life: the core ends it when the login logs out or expires, and when a policy.yaml reload removes broker.health or the principal. supervisor_unresponsive clears when its supervisor answers again, worker_unkillable when list_workers no longer lists the worker, and both when their supervisor is gone — the manifest removed or its socket refusing, which an operator's container restart leaves behind. An alert names TSB's components only: never a pid, a path or a hostname (Contract §4).

instances.note: a clear must name its raise
worker_unkillable names its worker, as the audit event does
